label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss) is FP - user input flows through param into sql which is HTML-encoded via encodeForHTML() before reaching the response sink, preventing XSS exploitation. Alert 2 (java/sql-injection) is TP - user input from getParameterMap() flows directly into the SQL string without sanitization before JDBCtemplate.execute(), enabling SQL injection attacks.

evidence.note: User input retrieved from request parameters via getParameterMap() and stored in param variable
